channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kon Knueppel | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kon Knueppel from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Kon Knueppel, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards playing point guard and Wolves picking up LaMelo Ball:

“In the playoffs it was just double team after double team. We got to get him back to his natural position off the ball. We didn’t create enough catch and shoot threes for him and when you look at the numbers with LaMelo on the floor with his teammates and the efficiency and the production, I mean Kon Knueppel shot 7% higher from the three-point line with LaMelo on the floor than he did without. I mean that’s a massive stat for a great shooter and that’s a big bump for a great shooter.”

Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Kon Knueppel, Anthony Edwards, Aug 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Lee on Jamal Murray, Kon Knueppel
item.description:
“Overall he's having a great year for anybody in the NBA. I saw something that was great. For somebody that is shooting 48% or better from the field, 40% from three and averaging 18 plus points per game or higher, there's only three players in the NBA doing that, and that's [Kevin] Durant, it's Kon Knueppel and it's Jamal Murray from Denver. And so those are two All-Star guys and he's in the same conversation with them, too. So it's pretty incredible what he's doing as a rookie, the historical feats that he's matching, but he's also just been really efficient as an NBA player.”

Charles Lee on Jamal Murray, Kon Knueppel, Apr 9, 2026. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Kon Knueppel
item.description:
Cooper Flagg on facing former teammate Kon Knueppel:

“It’s incredible. Like, I know Kon better than a lot of people. I know what his work ethic is like. I know his drive and how much of a competitor he is. That was probably one of, if not the most fun game of the season for me. He had an incredible game. We were going back and forth. It came down to the wire. Obviously would have loved to win it, but it was still a really fun game.”

Cooper Flagg on Kon Knueppel, Mar 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charles Lee on Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel
item.description:
Hornets coach Charles Lee on how Kon Knueppel has handled the Rookie of the Year race with Cooper Flagg:

“I think he's done great. I don't even think it's close. I think Kon's done a really good job continuing to separate himself & impact winning & have consistency to him on both ends of the floor. I do think their friendly competition & the fact they come from the same basketball program adds to it. But for the most part, Kon is a humble competitor who I don't even think gets caught up in it. He's probably gonna be mad at me for even saying something like that because he just wants to focus on our team & win games & impact it in any way he possibly can.”

Charles Lee on Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, Mar 3, 2026. Source: x.com.
